name: walk_child_hand_down
text: A person walking straight forward. Right arm extends diagonally down and outward to their right side and remains steady, gently holding the hand of an unseen toddler. Left arm is relaxed down at the side and swings naturally back and forth at thigh level with the gait. Neither hand is raised to the chest. Continue walking with normal alternating steps.

trim.reason: Select the reviewed complete middle cycle, avoiding start/end settling.

review.notes_zh: 右臂向身体右侧下方伸出，左手在腿边轻摆，持续小步前进；用右手向外15厘米的末端约束改正首版左手举到胸前的问题。只交成人自身姿态，不含小孩或双人接触保证。
review.review_frame_convention: review.png uses final delivered clip frame indices, beginning at 0.
